referenceKind: NCEP-NCAR Reanalysis 1 monthly 2m air-temperature climatology; not raw observations

sourceGrid.areaWeight: 94-point Gaussian quadrature weight per source cell; equal longitude widths cancel
sourceGrid.ordering: north-to-south rows, eastward columns; samples retain row-major source order
sourceGrid.cellAreaFraction: areaWeight / (2 * 192); no geographic area assigned to generated maps

air.long_name: Long Term Mean Monthly Mean of Air Temperature

units.sourceHeight: source model surface geopotential height in metres, not a high-resolution DEM or converted geometric altitude
units.longitude: degrees east in [0, 360); source coordinates, not a generated-map transform
units.monthlyTemperature: monthly climatological mean 2m air temperature in C, not instantaneous or land-surface temperature

period.aggregation: Day-weighted monthly-climatology approximation, not recovered daily data

sourceTime.interpretation: Synthetic year-0001 month labels, not dated observations; relative offsets establish Jan-Dec order. Absolute negative times are not decoded as proleptic Gregorian dates.

calendarInterpretation: Gregorian 1991-2020 month-day weights retain the annual fixture's explicit aggregation convention; the source time variable has no calendar attribute.
solarAlignment: none; monthly intervals are retained, but no solar phase, dated ephemeris or month-center instant is invented

selection.included: Every source cell with lsmask=-1, including polar and below-sea-level land; no neighborhood or height filter
selection.evaluationCrop: Optional abs(source latitude center)<=80 degrees; not a source extraction filter or partial-cell area remap
selection.belowSeaLevelHandling: Retained unchanged; downstream positive-above-sea model arms must explicitly separate these samples rather than silently clip the reference

cohorts.otherLandInterpretation: Outside the exact original low-relief cohort; not assumed statistically independent geography or new observations. Any no-training evaluation must explicitly exclude lowReliefMembership=train.

lowReliefCohort.membership: Exact sourceRow/sourceColumn join to frozen monthly fixture; original train/holdout labels preserved, not recomputed or expanded
